about_the_game:
GUIDE THE UNITED HUMANOID RACES TO VICTORY

As a space fleet commander, you take control of a powerful armada. Lead your ships to victory through skillful strategic action. Conquer planets to further enhance your strength.

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE​
Craft your own gameplay style by combining active and passive abilities. A multitude of builds is possible, each catering to individual tastes. Whether defensive or offensive, cunning or economical — there are no limits to the variety of playstyles.

CHALLENGE YOURSELF FOR GLORY AND HONOR

Choose mutators for your opponent to experience a special challenge. Increase your rewards and complete missions with special honors. For honor!

FEATURES

  • Single-player experience

  • Fast-paced, node-based strategy

  • Active and passive abilities

  • Individual builds and playstyles

  • 60 missions

  • Mutator and honor system for replayability

  • Challanges and achievements

  • Awesome soundtrack

  • For casual and hardcore players

name: Strength In Numbers
short_description: Take back control of the galaxy and defeat the evil AI in this fast-paced, node-based strategy game. The humanoid races need all the help they can get. We're counting on you, Commander!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese
